Looking at panel **l** (not panel i — likely a typo in the question, as panel i is immunofluorescence images and does not contain pathway enrichment data), we see a bar chart titled “LPS LD-high vs LD-low pathway enrichment”.

The top bar corresponds to:  
**“Negative regulation of protein metabolic process”**

Above this bar, there is an orange dot aligned with the x-axis value of **6**, and above that, the label “No. of genes” indicates that the number of genes for each pathway is shown by the position of the orange dot along the top axis.

For “Negative regulation of protein metabolic process”, the orange dot is at **6** on the “No. of genes” scale.

Thus, the number of differentially expressed genes involved in this pathway is **6**.
